explication: OpenAI Agents SDK is a provider-agnostic framework for agent workflows. The principal path is application input into Runner, through the run loop, model interaction, tool or handoff execution, and a final RunResult. Guardrails, sessions, tracing, MCP, sandbox workspaces, realtime agents, and voice pipelines are distinct capabilities. The tree and README establish these subsystem boundaries; sampled excerpts most directly confirm run orchestration support, voice processing, MCP lifecycle, sandbox persistence, and tracing-related error handling.
